$comment: What AOBPRINTER emits for one DB4 printed from PracSoft3. Extends the existing PrintJobEnvelopeDto (POST /inbound/print-jobs) with a fifth documentType. Everything the driver READ but may not SEND is listed in DB4-AND-AOBL.md section 2: the Medicare card number and IRN (hard rule 1), the Benefit Assigned amounts (hard rule 4), the privacy boilerplate, and the pathology tick box (out of scope, s 65C(4) items 1-4). The driver never asserts the form's version; the server decides that from formCode and parserTemplateVersion, because it is regulated content that changes. Identities below are the scanned example's; in fixtures use obviously fake ones.

services.description: Professional attendance (the attendance service) by a general practitioner, a medical practitioner or a prescribed medical practitioner, at which a general practice support service is provided
